What this experiment shows

METHOD & SCOPE

The server owns the game and runs both players. The controller compares legal candidates using predefined features. The opponent is identified above; game outcomes count only completed records.

The brain and retina show actual samples from the selection process. Between comparisons, the last received sample remains labeled. A connection interruption freezes these values instead of advancing a local substitute.

Move records expose inputs, comparison margins, seed and parameters. This is a software experiment with a frozen controller, not a chess-trained biological brain. The Wikipedia and learning experiments remain separate.
